narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.15 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 17.178-17.272 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 17.353; the first objective pays 0.94R at 17.111.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 17.178-17.272
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 17.353 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)

funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
